articles.headline: Yaxel Lendeborg scores 37 points, most by a Warriors rookie since Stephen Curry
articles.description: Yaxel Lendeborg hit six 3s and scored 37 points -- the most by a Warriors rookie since Stephen Curry in 2010 -- as Golden State beat the Clippers on Sunday night while resting Curry and Draymond Green.

images.name: Yaxel Lendeborg  [600x400]
images.caption: "One thing I'm proud of myself is my 3-point shot diet," Yaxel Lendeborg said Sunday. "Last year, if I would've missed like three 3s, I'm never shooting another one in the game. In Denver, I started off 0-for-5 and I kept shooting."

articles.headline: Luka Doncic has 45 points, 15 rebounds while leading Lakers to 131-125 victory over Raptors
articles.description: — Luka Doncic had 45 points, a season-high 15 rebounds, six assists and five steals in another prolific performance while leading the Los Angeles Lakers to a 131-125 victory over the Toronto Raptors on Sunday night.

articles.headline: Hawks' Flemings suspended for elbowing Pelicans' McGowens in head
articles.description: Hawks guard Kingston Flemings was suspended for a game by the NBA on Sunday night for intentionally elbowing Pelicans guard Bryce McGowens in the head.

articles.headline: Thunder decline option for oft-injured ex-lottery pick Nikola Topic
articles.description: The Thunder declined to pick up Nikola Topic's option for next season, making the Serbian point guard a free agent next summer.
